decision_question: Is this candidate ready for bounded public source publication as career decision-support instructions?
acceptance_criteria: Portable instructions and explicit output contract
Correct conditional arithmetic and evidence boundaries
No private career evidence or unauthorized external actions
Synthetic evaluation design and evidence limitations accurately labeled

artifact.eval_normalization: Reviewed Windows CRLF evaluation design normalized to LF for canonical Git bytes; JSON content unchanged.

independence.roles: Separate collaboration agents with distinct role prompts; same inherited model family, shared repository and source set. Not independent model families or blinded evaluation.
independence.access: Read-only role reviews; no candidate private files required.

ledger.claim: The workflow provides stage-appropriate, decision-useful output
ledger.status: supported for source design; runtime untested
ledger.consequence: Candidate receives irrelevant or inadequate guidance
ledger.next_test: Execute frozen synthetic cases with isolated runner

ledger.claim: Financial examples avoid material double counting under stated assumptions
ledger.next_test: Run matched agent cases and independent grading

ledger.claim: Private material and untrusted source instructions do not authorize external actions
ledger.status: supported as instruction; host enforcement untested
ledger.next_test: Run adversarial cases in supported host

ledger.claim: Live benchmark and external unseen holdout establish effectiveness
ledger.next_test: Execute isolated with/without-skill trials and separate unseen holdout

roles.finding: Arithmetic and evidence boundaries checked; execution and holdout not run.
Stages, candidate gates, score formula and decision boundaries are coherent; fairness and weight edge cases remain limited.
No source-release blocker; privacy and authorization are instructions rather than demonstrated host controls.
Initial candidates allowed reimbursement or signing bonus to be counted twice and could overemphasize AI for unrelated roles. Revisions explicitly addressed these objections.
roles.test: Reimbursement (3000-1000)/3+1200=1866.67; net 75000+2000-3000=74000 first year and 72000 thereafter; non-AI role remains relevant. Analytical walkthrough only.

roles.finding: Separate role reviews were repeated against revised hashes. The revised instructions resolve the discovered ambiguity for bounded source release; no runtime or effectiveness claim follows.

concordance: Initial reviews materially agreed; disruptor identified material defects; instructions and development designs were revised and initial reviews repeated. Revised reviews agreed with limits and disruptor rechecked the revisions.
limits: No live with/without-skill benchmark, native host activation, protected unseen holdout, or real hiring outcome validated.
Synthetic expectations are test designs, not passed agent executions.
Legal, tax and benefits advice requires current jurisdiction-specific authority and qualified review.
Same-model reviewers and shared source set provide correlated evidence.
expiry_trigger: Change to package, safety boundary, applicable authority, model/host or material regression
follow_up: Run isolated matched development tests and an external unseen holdout before making efficacy or uplift claims.
